container: Social media has changed how people build and maintain relationships. It allows friends and family to stay connected across long distances, share daily moments, and offer support quickly. Carefully edited posts may encourage comparisons, jealousy, or unrealistic expectations about other people’s lives. Notifications can also distract partners and friends during valuable time together. Healthy relationships benefit when people use social media thoughtfully, communicate openly, and set boundaries. Online platforms can strengthen bonds, but trust, empathy, and genuine attention remain essential for lasting connections.
